caption: The drawing consists of several objects arranged on a plain background. At the center bottom, there is a highly detailed and colored depiction of a brown leather pouch or bag with a flap and visible stitching, as well as two straps hanging over the top edge. The surface of the pouch shows areas of lighter and darker brown shades, giving it a textured, worn appearance. Below the pouch, there is a small, irregularly shaped, spiral object that is yellowish-brown in color with some shading to suggest depth. Surrounding the central image, four outlined sketches are arranged in a rectangular composition, each displaying different views or schematic renderings of the pouch and the smaller spiral object. These sketches are monochromatic, rendered in fine, light pencil lines without any color or shading. Two of the sketches show the pouch from different angles, one including an open flap and an interior compartment, while another smaller sketch shows the spiral object on its own. The sketches are boxed with simple rectangular borders, connected by thin lines. There are faint, handwritten notes beneath and above some of the sketches, along with the names “Mauriel G. Runyan” and “Exact Size” written along the bottom edge of the drawing. The overall composition presents a combination of detailed and schematic representations of the objects.
title: Cartridge Box and Bullet
